verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fellow publishes an llms.txt at developers.fellow.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing its API docs, and the reference pages are served as .md files, so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete or deep the llms.txt is (e.g. no llms-full.txt), a Fellow-hosted machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the standard OpenAPI paths return 404 and the spec only lives on ReadMe's registry), and independent corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
